project.name: 梦境还原系统
project.styleDefinitionBrief: 梦境主题产品界面，深邃夜空蓝底色搭配柔紫与暖金，营造空灵、超现实的沉浸式氛围。衬线展示字体搭配无衬线正文，呼应梦境的诗意与神秘感。
project.designRead: Product landing / dream enthusiasts / ethereal surreal / low density / avoid generic purple gradient AI hero

colorSystem.primaryColorRole: deep purple (#4A2D8A) as primary brand, night sky dark base (#0C0E1A), lavender (#B8A9E8) and gold (#D4A853) as ethereal accents
colorSystem.brandHuePolicy: single primary purple hue with ethereal accent tones (lavender, gold, aurora green/pink)
colorSystem.stateColors: aurora green for success, gold for warning, aurora pink for error, blue-ish for info

styleContinuityAnchors.shapeSystem: restrained radius scale: sm=4, md=8, lg=12, xl=16, full=9999. Dreamy rounded pill buttons, soft card corners.
styleContinuityAnchors.typographySystem: display: Playfair Display + Noto Serif SC (serif, dreamy poetic feel). body: Noto Sans SC + Inter (clean readability).
styleContinuityAnchors.spacingSystem: airy spacious layout with generous whitespace. 4/8/16/24/32/48/64/96px scale.
styleContinuityAnchors.componentLanguage: card-surface with glow borders, pill-shaped CTA buttons, gradient text accents, floating labels
styleContinuityAnchors.surfaceAndDepth: border + surface layering for static. Glow shadows (alpha<=0.08) for static surfaces. Deep shadows for floating modals.
styleContinuityAnchors.imageryAndIconography: surreal atmospheric imagery, starry sky textures, dreamy landscape scenes
styleContinuityAnchors.interactionTone: dreamy smooth transitions (600ms cubic-bezier), gentle hover lifts, soft focus effects

sharedProjectShellContract.navigationShell: minimal top nav bar with logo left, nav links center, CTA right. Dark glass morphism background.
sharedProjectShellContract.primaryColorSystem: deep purple primary (#4A2D8A), lavender accent (#B8A9E8), gold highlight (#D4A853)
sharedProjectShellContract.typographySystem: Playfair Display + Noto Serif SC for display. Noto Sans SC + Inter for body. Hero: 3.5rem. H1: 2.25rem. H2: 1.75rem. Body: 1rem.
sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: bg-base (#0C0E1A) > bg-surface (#13162B) > bg-elevated (#1A1E38). Border glow for static, deep shadow for floating.
sharedProjectShellContract.ctaStyle: pill-shaped filled gradient buttons (primary) or ghost outlined buttons (secondary). Dreamy hover transition.
sharedProjectShellContract.alignmentRules: center-aligned hero sections, left-aligned content sections. Generous whitespace rhythm.

pages.title: 梦境入口
pages.visualNorthStar: Immersive starry sky hero with a glowing text area where users describe dreams, surrounded by floating dream elements
pages.compositionPattern: full-bleed hero with centered content, staggered feature cards below

pages.title: 梦境场景
pages.visualNorthStar: Full-screen dream scene visualization with layered surreal imagery, dream metadata displayed in a translucent sidebar panel
pages.compositionPattern: asymmetric split — 70% dream scene visualization, 30% metadata sidebar

pages.title: 梦境图鉴
pages.visualNorthStar: Masonry-like gallery of past dreams with ethereal card treatment, soft hover animations, and category filters
pages.compositionPattern: filter bar + 3-column masonry grid of dream cards
